plan.notes: Hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from Webster University's official 'Undergraduate Course Sequence and Degree Plans | College of Humanities and Social Sciences' page (International Relations), Four-Year Program Sequence, Effective Catalog 2025-2026. Semester totals match the page's stated totals (15 x 8 = 120). Page header bands read GCP 30 / Major 36 / Elective 48 = 114, which contradicts the detailed sequence; the detailed semester-by-semester sequence is internally consistent and sums to the 120-credit graduation requirement, so the sequence is transcribed verbatim and the band discrepancy is documented here. INTL 4000 Research Requirement and INTL 4620 Major Overview are 0-credit required checkpoints (required_zero). The foreign-language slot counts toward GCP per the source. Prerequisites are not listed in the sequence; prereq arrays are empty (chains live in the catalog course descriptions).
